presets.name: Dairy-free
presets.summary: Drops cheese, milk, sour cream, and butter. A dish that needs dairy is left out of generated weeks; a dish where dairy is optional is planned without it.

presets.name: Gluten-free
presets.summary: Drops pasta, breads, tortillas, flour, and soy sauce. A dish built on one of those is left out of generated weeks; a dish where one is optional is planned without it.

presets.name: Low-carb
presets.summary: Drops rice, potatoes, pasta, and breads. A dish built on one of those is left out of generated weeks; a dish where the starch is a removable side is planned without it.

presets.name: No pork
presets.summary: Pork dinners are left out of generated weeks.

presets.name: Vegetarian
presets.summary: Generated weeks plan only from the recipes tagged Vegetarian in the recipe library (egg, cheese, and bean dinners).
